questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Which tag is used for the largest heading?
questions.explanation: <h1> is the largest and most important heading. Headings range from h1 (largest) to h6 (smallest).

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: What does HTML stand for?
questions.explanation: HTML = HyperText Markup Language. 'HyperText' refers to links between pages.

questions.subject: HTML
questions.question: Where does the visible page content go?
questions.explanation: <body> contains everything users see. <head> holds metadata like the page title.
